[[File:Icefiend icon.png|left]]
An '''icefiend''' is a monster found on top of [[Ice Mountain]]. During [[Recipe for Disaster]] players must kill one of these to cool down the [[Dwarven rock cake]] but players can also do this with the [[ice gloves]]. Icefiends may be assigned as a [[Slayer assignment]] from a [[Slayer Master]]. During the quest [[Perils of Ice Mountain]], the player is assigned to capture [[baby icefiend]]s for a [[gnomes|gnome]] named [[Professor Arblenap]], who is trying to save them from extinction.

[[Icefiend (God Wars Dungeon)|Level 84 versions]] can be found in the [[God Wars Dungeon]], and the [[Icefiend (Ghorrock)|level 107 versions]] can be found within [[Ghorrock|Ghorrock Fortress]] after completing [[The Temple at Senntisten]]. They generally hit higher than other [[monsters]] of their [[combat level]].

* {{UL|type=patch|update=This Week In RuneScape: Ninja Strike 26 - Souped Up Statues|date=13 September 2021}}
** The Icefiends on Ice Mountain will no longer attack using fire.

* {{UL|type=patch|update=Patch Notes (19 August 2019)|date=19 August 2019}}
** Fixed an issue where Ice fiends killed on [[Ice Mountain]] were not counted towards slayer assignments.

* {{UL|type=patch|update=Patch Notes (12 June 2017)|date=12 June 2017}}
** Icefiends on Ice Mountain now drop souls that can be collected by [[Ushabti]] Jars.

* {{UL|type=patch|update=Patch Notes (23 November 2015)|date=23 November 2015}}
** Corrected the melee attack accuracy for the following NPCs: [[Dagannoth Mother]], Dominion Tower Dagannoth Mother, [[Temple at Senntisten]] quest fiends and [[Cockatrices]].

* {{UL|type=ninja|update=Patch Notes (26 August 2014)|date=26 August 2014}}
** [[Pyrefiend]] and icefiend models and animations have been updated to use the God Wars models and animations.

* {{UL|type=patch|update=Patch Notes (4 December 2012)|date=4 December 2012}}
** Icefiends have been updated.

* {{UL|type=patch|update=Patch Notes (8 March 2011)|date=8 March 2011}}
** Icefiends now correctly drop [[impious ashes]].

* {{UL|type=update|update=Hundredth Quest - Recipe for Disaster!|date=15 March 2006}}
** Added to game.
}}

==Trivia==
* When standing still, icefiends appear to shiver occasionally.
* Icefiends don't count towards a [[slayer task]] when [[recoil]]ed to death. This bug has been known since at least 2015, and has yet to be fixed. The only way to finish the task is to get someone else to [[co-op]] with and have them kill the icefiends.
* Despite being ice demons, they attack with [[Fire Strike]].
